tasks.short: Assist coroners, file actual police reports and testify when employed by a coroner.

steps.what: Assist the coroner at actual death scenes or autopsies and capture assigned factual observations
inputs: actual coroner direction and assigned duties
outputs: actual assistance and worker-captured factual observations

steps.what: Write the actual assigned police report using native case-reference and report-heading fields
inputs: actual assistance and worker-captured factual observations
actual case reference supplied by coroner's office
outputs: complete proposed factual police report and filing destination

steps.what: Check the complete final report against actual observations and exact police filing destination
inputs: complete proposed factual police report and filing destination
actual assistance and worker-captured factual observations
outputs: checked exact final police report and destination

steps.what: File the exact checked report with the actual police recipient
inputs: checked exact final police report and destination
outputs: actual police filing receipt and filed report version

steps.what: Review actual records and clarify the scope of personal knowledge before the hearing
inputs: actual police filing receipt and filed report version
actual observation records and hearing request
outputs: reviewed factual record and limits of personal knowledge

steps.what: Testify personally at the actual inquest or court and answer questions within personal knowledge
inputs: reviewed factual record and limits of personal knowledge

tasks.design: Reuse native case-reference fields and report headings for the actual police report after physical coroner assistance. Retain all fresh observations, factual report writing, complete final-report checking, separate police filing, hearing preparation and personal testimony; no cause-of-death conclusion or testimony is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable case references and report headings can be repeatedly typed within actual assigned police reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case-record forms can reuse those stable fields.
tasks.still_hard: Actual scene work, source fidelity and testimony remain personal professional responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a directly observed fact from an inference or another person's statement.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated report fields while preserving personal factual accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case forms can reuse stable references and headings without performing autopsy assistance, factual interpretation or testimony.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the coroner office's actual case-record application and GOV_PORTAL the actual police filing interface. Shares40/30/4/1/10/15 are provisional, not measured, for an episode containing the listed duties. Use only if actually employed by a coroner; ordinary embalming does not acquire these duties.

s1 counts fresh assigned observation capture. s2 removes3 repeated field/heading points, retaining27 of actual report writing and ordinary ungated internal saves. s3 is the existing final factual check before actual external filing, not an extra approval before saving. If the real coroner reviews reports, map that existing reviewer separately; do not treat another person's review as saved focal labour.

The funeral notice digest does not establish coroner-report or testimony automation. No free transcript, fabricated observation, generated expert conclusion or substitute witness is proposed. Actual hearings may occur later or not at all; reweight real episodes rather than treating all duties as universal.
unknowns: Which actual police filing route and existing final report reviewer apply?
research_questions: Observe repeated case fields separately from factual report drafting and confirm actual employment/duty scope.
